'''Talee''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as an [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]] agent in charge of inspecting vessels arriving at [[Cloudscape Platforms]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
